title: Enhancement: Enable ASIC temperature polling by default on Nexthop Platforms
author: frank-nexthop
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Medium

### Description of the enhancement

This enhancement should by default enable polling of ASIC temperature sensors for all Nexthop platforms by setting the "ASIC_SENSORS_POLLER_STATUS" and "ASIC_SENSORS_POLLER_INTERVAL" flags in the database. 

### Current Behavior

When the "ASIC_SENSORS_POLLER_STATUS" and "ASIC_SENSORS_POLLER_INTERVAL" flags are not set in the config, ASIC temperatures aren't reported properly from 'show plat temp'.

### Proposed Behavior

Even if "ASIC_SENSORS_POLLER_STATUS" and "ASIC_SENSORS_POLLER_INTERVAL" flags are not set in the config, the ASIC temperature sensors should report accurate values from 'show plat temp'.

linkedPullRequests.title: sonic-platform-modules-nexthop: Enable ASIC polling by default
linkedPullRequests.author: frank-nexthop
linkedPullRequests.body:
Within the Nexthop asic thermal class, set ASIC polling database values to platform.json defaults on the first polling iteration

fixes #26516

#### Why I did it
Currently, for Nexthop platforms, ASIC polling is not present in the config by default. This causes all ASIC temperatures to be displayed as 0 when running `show plat temp`.

##### Work item tracking
- Microsoft ADO **(number only)**:

#### How I did it
When thermalctld is started, when the temperatures are first polled, the Nexthop specific platform code will guarantee that the ASIC polling database values are set to the defaults set in platform.json. For all Nexthop platforms right now, this means that ASIC polling will be enabled by default.

#### How to verify it
Built a sonic image with this change, and loaded it onto a Nexthop device. Confirmed that on first boot ASIC polling works properly without any manual changes to the configuration/database.
